items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: I think at that time he was going with a Gonzales woman.

ctx.x: Yeah. But there's a lot of things that are on here. Well, what is the significance of the tune Mama Mita? Was that...?
Mama Mita? Is it down there as Mama Mita?
Yeah, the first one, Mama Mita. M as in Mike, I-T-A.
